profile: AI Engineering Lead running Hermes Agent on Telegram. Heavy multi-agent pipeline with optimized cost routing. 50% coding, 30% research, 20% documentation. Runs 15+ daily web_search/web_extract chains, 10+ skills hub calls, every session auto-compressed. Sensitive to TTFT latency. Target: <350ms, zero truncation, 1M+ context.
profile_detail: Current stack: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (Default, Vision, Web Extract, MCP, Triage) at $0.25/$1.50, Ring-2.6-1T:Free (Compression, Session Search, Skills Hub, Approval, Triage) at $0.00, DeepSeek V3.2 (Curator) at $0.252/$0.378. Before HAA: Opus 4.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-4o — bloated and expensive.

tasks.name: Default Chat
tasks.rationale: Default Chat handles 20+ calls/day. Flash Lite at $0.25/$1.50 delivers lowest TTFT with 1M context. Qwen3.5 Plus ($0.30/$1.80) offers marginal quality gains but adds ~$15/month at current volume. Keep current assignment.

tasks.name: Vision Analysis
tasks.rationale: Vision tasks run ~10x/week. Flash Lite handles Telegram screenshots, PDF figures, and chart parsing at $0.25/$1.50. Gemini 3.1 Pro ($2/$12) is 8x more expensive for minimal quality gain at low frequency. Keep Flash Lite.

tasks.name: Web Extract
tasks.rationale: Web Extract runs 15+ times/day — highest frequency task. Flash Lite's 1M context handles full-page extraction without chunking. DeepSeek V3.2 ($0.252/$0.378) is competitive on price but limited to 131K context, forcing multi-chunk extraction on long pages. Flash Lite wins on coverage and speed.

tasks.name: Compression
tasks.rationale: Compression runs 5x/day with zero cost on Ring-2.6-1T:free. Switching to Gemini 2.5 Flash ($0.30/$2.50) would add ~$4/month for no practical quality gain. Ring's 262K window handles session histories well. Free tier wins decisively.

tasks.name: Session Search
tasks.rationale: Session Search is context-heavy — needs to scan 130K+ token histories for semantic matches. Llama 3.2 3B (131K context) clips longer sessions. Ring-2.6-1T:free offers 262K context (2x) at the same $0.00 price, plus stronger reasoning for query understanding. Zero cost upgrade with direct latency and coverage improvement.

tasks.name: Skills Hub
tasks.rationale: Skills Hub routes 10+ complex multi-step workflows daily. Ring-2.6-1T was purpose-built for agentic tool orchestration with native function calling support. Llama 3.2 3B handles simple routing but struggles with conditional chains. Both are free — Ring's superior reasoning directly reduces tool misrouting and retry overhead.

tasks.name: Approval
tasks.rationale: Approval decisions involve nuanced risk assessment (cost thresholds, content safety, tool authorization). Ring-2.6-1T's reasoning capability catches edge cases Llama 3.2 3B misses. Zero cost differential makes this a pure quality upgrade with better guardrails.

tasks.name: MCP Tooling
tasks.rationale: MCP Tooling demands structured output and multi-tool orchestration — Ring-2.6-1T was explicitly designed for this. Switching saves ~$48/month (8x/day at $0.25/$1.50). Ring's native function calling eliminates prompt engineering overhead.

tasks.name: Title Generation
tasks.rationale: Title generation is a lightweight task that does not justify $0.25 input cost per call. Ring-2.6-1T:free handles concise summarization natively and costs $0. Running 10x/day, this eliminates ~$7.50/month in pure waste.

tasks.name: Triage Specifier
tasks.rationale: Triage routing requires multi-class reasoning (urgency, topic, tool requirements). Ring-2.6-1T's thinking model architecture excels at classification tasks. At $0 vs $0.25/$1.50 per call with 5x daily frequency, this saves ~$37/month while improving routing accuracy.

tasks.name: Curator
tasks.rationale: DeepSeek V3.2 is the direct successor to V3 0324 with improved Sparse Attention and RL post-training. Price drops from $0.32/$0.89 to $0.252/$0.378 (21% cheaper input, 57% cheaper output). At Curator's 6x/day frequency, monthly savings reach ~$12.
